# ASPECT RATIOS AND LTX /32 IMPACT ON THEM

480 x 277 (16:9) (LTX crops to 480 x 256)
480 x 201 (2.39:1) (LTX crops to 480 x 192)

640 x 480 (4:3)

832 x 480 (16:9 (LTX crops to 832 x 448)
960 x 402 (2.39:1) (LTX crops to 960 x 384)

# CONTROLNET GROUP

leave this disdabled and provide your own controlnet video is the best way but I leave this in because it was in already

# 1ST SAMPLER SAVE OUTPUT GROUP

Enable this on first run if you want to see video stage and save the latent (allows for use in other wf later if you need it). 

then disable it.

# TEMPORAL UPSCALE GROUP

I leave this enabled since the results of a controlnet driven video should be known.

This hugly improves quality of final result. finishes in 36 mins for me which is acceptable for the results.

# First FRame & Last Frame

If using only first frame ref then reduce LTXVImgToVideoInplaceKJ to 1 image

if using FF and LF then set it to 2 images, both str 1, and 0 index for first frame, -1 for last frame.

# LTXV-2.3 Model Files & Dependencies

## Diffusion Model
**LTXV-2.3 DEV GGUF Q4_K_M**  
*Place in:* `diffusion_models`

- [ltx-2.3-22b-dev_Q4_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/vantagewithai/LTX-2.3-GGUF/blob/main/dev/ltx-2-3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf)

---

## Distilled LoRA
**LTX-2 19B DISTILLED LORA**  
*Place in:* `loras`

- [ltx-2-19b-distilled-lora](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTXV2_comfy/resolve/main/loras/ltx-2-19b-distilled-lora_resized_dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_175_fp8.safetensors)

## Text Encoder

- [gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors)

## Audio & Video VAE
**LTX-2.3 VAE Files**

- [LTX-2.3 VAE Folder](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/tree/main/vae)

## Spatial Upscaler
**LTX-2.3 Spatial Upscaler ×2 (v1.0)**

- [ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors)

# MARKDKBERRY.COM

Follow me on Patreon for more here https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies

all tutorials discussions and instructions for how I use workflows are on my YT Channel - [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

---

## PURPOSE OF THIS WORKFLOW

This has been adapted. original was used to make videos from depthmap+pose controlnets using a ref image to guide it (FF and LF work best to maintain characters) and the Lora for Union Control but I find it works better using the original video instead of depthmap.

I am using this to upscale video and improve quality while keeping consistency using 1 or 2 ref images (FF, LF).

---

Currently testing as part of my video pipeline using Bernini video inbound and 832 x 480 @ 24fps as the size. If results remain good I will use RTX Nvidia to upscale the final output.

## WHAT WORKS

- give the same prompt to this wf that you use to create the original video you send into this wf.


## TO TEST

- does it need to reduce the image sizes before sending them through or can I let ImageToVideoInPlaceKJ node deal with sizing? </br>
